mintAuthority.summary: EUROT uses direct, immutable StableCoin deployments on Ethereum, Avalanche, and Polygon. On Ethereum and Avalanche, EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb is both owner and supply manager. On Polygon, EOA 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077 is both owner and supply manager, while the same Avalanche EOA is the live proposed owner and can claim ownership immediately. Each current owner or supply manager can mint without an on-chain supply cap. The contracts' separate ExternallyTransferable burn/mint rail is assessed under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: EUROT Avalanche supply-manager and owner EOA
controls.capDescription: StableCoin.mint(uint256) has no aggregate supply ceiling and permits either supplyManager() or owner() to mint.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 90233120, owner() and supplyManager() both returned 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb, proposedOwner() was zero, and eth_getCode on the authority returned 0x. Verified StableCoin source permits the owner or supply manager to call uncapped mint(uint256).

controls.label: EUROT Polygon supply-manager and owner EOA
controls.capDescription: StableCoin.mint(uint256) has no aggregate supply ceiling and permits either supplyManager() or owner() to mint.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90179923, owner() and supplyManager() both returned 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077 and eth_getCode returned 0x. The runtime hash matched Avalanche exactly for this asset, and verified StableCoin source permits the owner or supply manager to call uncapped mint(uint256).

controls.label: EUROT Polygon pending-owner EOA
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90179923, proposedOwner() returned 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb. Verified Claimable ownership lets this EOA call claimOwnership without another current-owner action, after which owner() can mint or replace the supply manager immediately. eth_getCode returned 0x.

controls.label: EUROT Ethereum supply-manager and owner EOA
controls.capDescription: StableCoin.mint(uint256) has no aggregate supply ceiling and permits either supplyManager() or owner() to mint.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771272 on 2026-08-16, owner() and supplyManager() both returned 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb, proposedOwner() was zero, and eth_getCode on the authority returned 0x. The immutable verified StableCoin source permits the owner or supply manager to call uncapped mint(uint256).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771272, Avalanche block 92986796, and Polygon block 92148079 on 2026-08-16, the three EUROT deployments were direct contracts with no proxy, beacon, implementation, or admin path. The verified StableCoin runtime was identical across the reviewed deployments. Ethereum and Avalanche owner and supply manager were EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb; Polygon owner and supply manager were EOA 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077, with the Avalanche EOA staged as proposed owner. Verified source permits each current owner or supply manager to mint uncapped supply and permits the proposed owner to claim Polygon ownership without delay. Mint Authority covers only these native issuance paths; the separate ExternallyTransferable externalTransfer burn and externalTransferFrom arbitrary-mint rail is assessed under bridgeRouteRisk with its unresolved route machinery and controller failure domains. No named independent attestor, recurring cadence, or dated reserve-to-liability report is public; Token Teknoloji's proof-of-reserves page is issuer-reported and ad hoc, so it does not reconcile the whole Ethereum, Avalanche, and Polygon liability set. Turkey's Capital Markets Board list matches Token Teknoloji A.S. as being in liquidation, not as an actively prudentially supervised stablecoin issuer. The existing authority posture remains unbounded-or-compromised, with unbounded cap semantics, unknown reconciliation, and no supervision.
